use_case: Pricing and personalized offers engine: dynamic online prices within plus or minus 10% of shelf price, and weekly personalized digital coupons (including supplier-funded offers) for about 148,000 loyalty members
vendor_or_model: Pricing and offers engine SaaS vendor (machine learning demand and recommendation models; VEN-07)
data_categories: Loyalty purchase history; home ZIP code; delivery zone; payment tender type including an EBT flag (to be removed); item cost, shelf price, stock, and sales velocity; supplier campaign rules
consequential_decision_category: None (retail prices and offers are not a consequential decision category)
human_in_the_loop: Director of E-commerce and Marketing sets price bounds, cost floor, excluded items, and campaign rules; daily exception review; one-step freeze of online prices to shelf prices; second-person check of supplier campaign settings; monthly fairness review by the AI review group
applicable_laws: N44-45-R02 FTC Act Section 5, 15 U.S.C. 45(a)(1) and 45(n); Fla. Stat. 501.160 (price gouging during a declared state of emergency); privacy notice commitments (POL-01 4.14, 4.15)
status: In production since 2026-01; approved with conditions 2026-09-15

use_case: Demand forecasting and replenishment: weekly item and store forecasts that propose store and DC order quantities for buyer approval
business_owner: Chief Financial Officer (BP-17); used by the Director of Merchandising and the Distribution Center Director
vendor_or_model: Forecasting SaaS vendor (machine learning time-series models) fed from the data warehouse
data_categories: Aggregated sales by item, store, and day; promotions; holidays; weather; no personal data
human_in_the_loop: Buyers approve or change every proposed order; manual override during declared emergencies and supplier shortages
applicable_laws: None specific to AI; contract and SOC 2 terms (POL-01 4.10)
status: In production since 2025; approved 2026-09-15 with monitoring

use_case: Self-checkout computer vision: overhead cameras at the 20 self-checkouts (4 per store) detect items that may not have been scanned, alert the attendant, and show the customer a replay
business_owner: Director of Store Operations (with the Director of Loss Prevention)
vendor_or_model: Self-checkout vision add-on from the POS vendor (image classification model; vendor cloud)
data_categories: Video clips of the scan and bagging area (customer faces are in frame in about a third of clips); item scans; transaction ID; no loyalty or payment data
consequential_decision_category: None (store loss prevention); re-tier to High if used to identify, ban, or detain individuals
human_in_the_loop: Attendant reviews every alert and the replay before speaking to the customer; standard non-accusatory script; no detention; Loss Prevention reviews disputes
applicable_laws: N44-45-R02 FTC Act Section 5, 15 U.S.C. 45(a)(1) and 45(n) (accuracy, privacy, and biometric practices; Rite Aid order, Dec 2023, as an enforcement signal); Fla. Stat. 501.171(2)
status: In production since 2025-10; approved with conditions 2026-09-15

use_case: Customer service chatbot on the website and app: answers questions on orders, substitutions, refunds, store hours, and products, and hands off to staff
business_owner: Director of Customer Service (with the Director of E-commerce and Marketing)
vendor_or_model: Chatbot SaaS vendor (large language model with a retrieval knowledge base)
data_categories: Customer name, email, order numbers, and free-text messages; full card numbers typed by customers in 11 of about 27,500 chats reviewed (May to July 2026)
human_in_the_loop: Handoff to staff on request from 8:00 to 20:00; allergen, recall, and refund-exception questions must go to staff; refunds are issued only by staff
applicable_laws: N44-45-R02 FTC Act Section 5, 15 U.S.C. 45(a)(1) (accuracy of answers and AI disclosure); N44-45-R01 PCI DSS v4.0.1 3.2 and 4.2 (card numbers entered in chat); Fla. Stat. 501.171(2)
status: In production since 2026-02; conditional: fixes by 2026-11-30 or switch to scripted FAQ mode

use_case: Facial recognition for loss prevention: vendor proposal to match store CCTV faces against a watch list of people linked to past thefts
vendor_or_model: Facial recognition vendor (proposal only; not purchased)
data_categories: Facial images and face templates of all customers who enter a store; watch-list entries
consequential_decision_category: None in the rubric categories; treated as High by company rule (biometric identification of customers)
applicable_laws: N44-45-R02 FTC Act Section 5, 15 U.S.C. 45(a) and 45(n) (FTC Rite Aid order, Dec 2023: 5-year ban on facial recognition for surveillance); Fla. Stat. 501.171(2)
status: Proposed; rejected 2026-09-15 and listed as a prohibited use

use_case: Hiring screening module in the applicant tracking system: knockout questions and a machine learning fit score for hourly store and DC applicants; applicants below the cut score are rejected automatically
vendor_or_model: Applicant tracking SaaS vendor screening module (machine learning ranking model)
data_categories: Application answers; availability; work history including gaps; home ZIP code used for commute distance; voluntary self-identification data kept separately for adverse impact testing
human_in_the_loop: Today: recruiters review only applicants above the cut score. Required: auto-reject off by 2026-10-31 and recruiter review of every applicant; interim weekly review of all auto-rejected applicants since 2026-09-08
applicable_laws: Title VII, 42 U.S.C. 2000e-2(k) (disparate impact) with 29 CFR 1607.4(D) four-fifths rule as the screening threshold; ADEA, 29 U.S.C. 623(a) and 631(a); ADA, 42 U.S.C. 12112(b)(6); Florida Civil Rights Act, Fla. Stat. 760.10; N44-45-R02 FTC Act Section 5 (vendor claims)
status: In production since 2026-03; approved with conditions 2026-09-15 (auto-reject off by 2026-10-31)

use_case: Enterprise generative AI assistant for drafting marketing copy, product descriptions, procedures, and meeting summaries
vendor_or_model: Enterprise generative AI assistant (vendor SaaS; no training on company data; sign-in through the identity provider)
data_categories: Internal and Confidential business content; no Restricted data (customer, card, loyalty, or employee personal data)
human_in_the_loop: Staff edit every draft; pricing, savings, health, and nutrition claims go through the POL-01 4.14 claims review before publication
applicable_laws: N44-45-R02 FTC Act Section 5, 15 U.S.C. 45(a)(1) (claims in generated copy)
status: In production (enterprise license since 2026-06); approved 2026-09-15; personal AI accounts to be blocked by 2026-10-31
